factions.name: Albion — Realm of Knights and Honor
factions.ideology: Chivalry, honor, and the legacy of King Arthur
factions.description: Albion represents the kingdom of the late King Arthur — a realm of knights, damsels, and high magic. Its warriors fight with sword and shield, its wizards command the elements, and its paladins channel divine power. Albion draws upon Arthurian legend and seeks to restore the glory of Camelot through martial might and arcane mastery.

military_branches.name: Knights of the Round Table
military_branches.description: The elite heavy cavalry and melee warriors of Albion, inspired by Arthur's legendary knights

military_branches.name: Order of Merlin
military_branches.description: The arcane spellcasters of Albion, wielding elemental and spirit magic

military_branches.name: Divine Healers
military_branches.description: Clerics and Friars who channel divine power to heal and smite

military_branches.name: Shadow Operatives
military_branches.description: Stealth-based assassins and infiltrators who strike from the shadows

military_branches.name: Rangers of the Plains
military_branches.description: Longbow-wielding scouts and rangers who patrol the Salisbury Plains

military_branches.name: Musical Support
military_branches.description: Minstrels who buff allies with songs and provide crowd control

key_leaders.name: King Arthur
key_leaders.role: The legendary king, deceased — his legacy drives Albion

key_leaders.name: Merlin
key_leaders.role: The great wizard; source of Albion's arcane knowledge

key_leaders.name: Morgana
key_leaders.role: Arthur's sister; dark sorceress who raises the undead

key_leaders.name: Guinevere
key_leaders.role: The betrayed queen; symbol of Albion's tragedy

key_leaders.name: Lancelot
key_leaders.role: The greatest knight; his betrayal weakened the Round Table

strengths: Balanced class composition with strong tanks and healers
Paladin class provides unique holy warrior capability
Wizard class has the highest single-target damage in the game
Strong defensive capabilities with Armsman tanks
Excalibur relic provides powerful realm bonuses
Diverse magic types: elemental, spirit, divine, and dark
weaknesses: Fewer nature-based classes compared to Hibernia
Reliant on legacy of Arthur — morale suffers when relics are lost

factions.name: Hibernia — Realm of Nature and Magic
factions.ideology: Harmony with nature, primal magic, and the power of the Otherworld
factions.description: Hibernia is the land of forest and magic, closest to nature of all the realms. Its people — Celts, Elves, Firbolg, and more — live in harmony with the natural world, drawing power from the earth, the Otherworld, and primal magic. Hibernians are the most magically inclined of all realms, with almost every class supporting some form of spellcasting. They seek to protect the natural world and expand the reach of the Otherworld.

military_branches.name: Nature's Guardians
military_branches.description: Druids and Animists who wield the power of the forest

military_branches.name: Otherworld Casters
military_branches.description: Elven and Sylvan spellcasters who channel primal and arcane magic

military_branches.name: Warriors of the Glen
military_branches.description: Melee fighters who combine martial prowess with nature magic

military_branches.name: Shadow Stalkers
military_branches.description: Stealth-based rogues and dark magic users

military_branches.name: Forest Rangers
military_branches.description: Archers who combine ranged combat with magical abilities

military_branches.name: Musical Support
military_branches.description: Bards who buff allies with Celtic songs and provide crowd control

military_branches.name: Voice of the Otherworld
military_branches.description: Banshees whose sound-based magic devastates enemies

key_leaders.name: Lugh
key_leaders.role: Celtic god of skill and light; his spear is Hibernia's Power Relic

key_leaders.name: Dagda
key_leaders.role: Celtic father god; his cauldron is Hibernia's Strength Relic

key_leaders.name: The Morrigan
key_leaders.role: Phantom queen, goddess of war and fate

key_leaders.name: Cernunnos
key_leaders.role: Horned god of the forest and animals

key_leaders.name: The Unseelie Court
key_leaders.role: Dark fey who corrupt the natural world — Hibernia's internal threat

strengths: Most magically diverse realm — almost all classes can cast spells
Strong nature magic with Druid and Animist classes
Vampiir class provides unique life-drain capabilities
Champion class is one of the best pure tanks in the game
Spear of Lugh relic provides powerful magical bonuses
Strong crowd control through Bard and Mentalist classes
weaknesses: Fewer pure melee classes — most rely on magic
Internal conflict with the Unseelie Court weakens the realm
Less heavy armor coverage than Albion

factions.name: Midgard — Realm of Norse Might
factions.ideology: Strength, honor, and the power of the Norse gods
factions.description: Midgard is the land of trolls and giants, a harsh and unforgiving realm where only the strong survive. Its people — Norsemen, Dwarves, Trolls, and more — draw power from the ancient Norse gods: Odin, Thor, and Freyja. They are warriors, shamans, and rune-masters who fight with brutal efficiency. Midgard seeks to prove its dominance through sheer martial might and divine power.

military_branches.name: Viking Warriors
military_branches.description: Frenzied melee fighters who channel the rage of battle

military_branches.name: Rune Masters
military_branches.description: Spellcasters who inscribe powerful runes to channel divine power

military_branches.name: Divine Healers
military_branches.description: Healers who channel the power of the Norse gods

military_branches.name: Spirit Summoners
military_branches.description: Castters who control undead and Norse spirits

military_branches.name: Shadow Operatives
military_branches.description: Stealth-based rogues and dual-wielding assassins

military_branches.name: Forest Hunters
military_branches.description: Ranged specialists who track and hunt their prey

military_branches.name: Musical Support
military_branches.description: Skalds who buff allies with Norse songs and battle cries

key_leaders.name: Odin
key_leaders.role: The Allfather; chief of the Norse gods. His spear Gungnir is Midgard's Strength Relic.

key_leaders.name: Thor
key_leaders.role: God of thunder; his hammer Mjolnir is Midgard's Power Relic

key_leaders.name: Freyja
key_leaders.role: Goddess of love, beauty, and war; chooser of the slain

key_leaders.name: Loki
key_leaders.role: The trickster god; source of Midgard's shadow magic

key_leaders.name: The Blodfelag
key_leaders.role: Treacherous cult that seeks to unleash Ragnarok — Midgard's internal threat

strengths: Strongest melee-focused realm with Berserker and Thane classes
Runemaster class provides unique rune-based magic
Spiritmaster class has the best summoning capabilities
Mjolnir relic provides powerful divine bonuses
Thane class combines tanking with lightning magic
Strong crowd control through Skald and Shaman classes
weaknesses: Fewest classes of any realm (12 unique + Mauler)
Less magical diversity than Albion and Hibernia
Internal threat from the Blodfelag cult
Fewer healing options — primarily reliant on Healer class

factions.name: Legion — Forces of Darkness Falls
factions.ideology: Chaos, destruction, and the corruption of all three realms
factions.description: Legion is the demonic lord of Darkness Falls, the underground dungeon that lies beneath the Frontiers. Its forces — demons, undead, and corrupted creatures — seek to corrupt all three realms and bring about the end of the world. Only the realm dominant in the Frontiers can enter Darkness Falls to challenge Legion.

military_branches.name: Demonic Host
military_branches.description: Demons and corrupted creatures that guard the depths of Darkness Falls

military_branches.name: Legion's Guard
military_branches.description: Elite demonic warriors that serve Legion directly

key_leaders.name: Legion
key_leaders.role: Demonic lord of Darkness Falls; the main boss of the dungeon

key_leaders.name: Dark Sub-bosses
key_leaders.role: Various demonic commanders that guard the paths to Legion

strengths: Controls the lucrative Darkness Falls dungeon
Demons are powerful and numerous
Can corrupt players who linger too long
RvR combat inside the dungeon adds chaos
weaknesses: Only accessible to the realm with the most frontier keeps
Constantly besieged by the dominant realm
Legion can be defeated, yielding powerful loot
